parameters.query:
with schedule(reminder_number, days_after_due) as (
  values (1, 1), (2, 14), (3, 30)
),
candidates as (
  select
    i.id, i.invoice_number, i.due_date, i.total_incl_btw, i.payment_url,
    c.email as client_email, c.phone as client_phone, c.name as client_name, t.company_name,
    (CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date) as days_overdue,
    coalesce((select max(r.reminder_number) from reminder_log r where r.invoice_id = i.id), 0) + 1 as next_reminder_number
  from invoices i
  join clients c on c.id = i.client_id
  join tenants t on t.id = i.tenant_id
  where i.status = 'overdue'
)
select cd.*
from candidates cd
join schedule s on s.reminder_number = cd.next_reminder_number
where cd.days_overdue >= s.days_after_due;

nodes.name: Volgende herinnering bepalen
nodes.notes: Oplopend schema: herinnering 1 op dag 1 na vervaldatum, herinnering 2 op dag 14, herinnering 3 (laatste waarschuwing) op dag 30. Daarna stuurt het systeem bewust niets meer automatisch — dat wordt een handmatige beslissing (bv. incasso).

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.next_reminder_number === 3 ? `Laatste herinnering: factuur ${$json.invoice_number}` : $json.next_reminder_number === 2 ? `Tweede herinnering: factuur ${$json.invoice_number} nog openstaand` : `Herinnering: factuur ${$json.invoice_number} is nog niet betaald` }}
